As for during His days:
Hadith.610 - It is narrated from Asma bint Umais that She said:
"One day, while the Messenger of Allah (sw) was resting with his head in the lap of Ali (as), the Asr prayer passed, and the sun had set.
The Prophet (sw) said: 'O’ Allah (swt), Ali was engaged in obedience to You and Your Messenger, so return the sun for him.'
Asma said: 'By Allah (swt), I saw the sun set, then it rose again after it had set, and no mountain or land remained except that it was illuminated by its light until Ali (as) stood, performed ablution, and prayed. Then the sun set again.'".
